newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gran Canaria cargo traffic up 30pct in Feb 97.
newsitem.headline: Gran Canaria cargo traffic up 30pct in Feb 97.

text.p: Spain's Gran Canaria airport handled 30 percent more cargo in February compared with the same month last year, the airport authority said.
Volume rose to 4,273 tonnes compared with 3,290 tonnes, taking the accumulated total this year to 8,199 tonnes.
The airport also handled 445 tonnes of mail in February, a 24 percent increase from February 1996.

Passenger numbers were 0.6 percent higher at 658,780 excluding transit passengers, taking the accumulated total to 1.37 million, 0.9 percent ahead of 1996. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
